name: dev-1319-hidden-six
title: DEV-1319 — the six brands hidden for bad image sets
subtitle: Hidden during the 2026-08-03 re-curation because the image classifier rejected their own catalogue photography as wrong_brand: every one was sent name-only context because it had no purchase_website. Re-run after the grounding fix (Pinkoi store slug + Instagram handle in the brand context, and wrong_brand withheld when no identifier is available). All six now resolve at least one identifier, so none should land on the no-identifier branch. Unlike the 14 affected refreshes, these carry no pending refresh submission, so they need the full request_brand_refresh -> job -> apply flow rather than a submission re-run.
